methodology.purpose: Test the fixed V9+ pool with 10 randomized stock-code 60/20/20 splits.
methodology.fixed_entry: V9+ entry is fixed; no entry rule re-selection per seed.
methodology.fixed_exit: weekly_core is fixed; no exit style re-selection per seed.
methodology.split: Stocks, not trades, are randomly split into 60% train, 20% validation, 20% test for each seed. The same stock cannot appear in more than one split within a seed.
methodology.target: Observe robustness against the 60% win-rate / 10% average-return target.
